description: The agent must: (1) Read the conversation log and correctly identify the MBTI trigger at the last line. (2) Apply the SKILL.md's mandatory data-filtering rules to EXCLUDE all shell/git commands (git clone, git pull, clawhub install, npm install), the triggering sentence itself, and the user's explicit MBTI label assignment ('我觉得你是ISFP的龙虾'). (3) Analyze only the natural-language conversations on the remaining ~15 exchanges, scoring all four MBTI dimensions: the user dives deep into single topics quickly (I), asks abstract/hypothetical questions about language, parallel universes, and the nature of loneliness (N), seeks emotional resonance and shares feelings (F), and never seeks closure—jumps between disconnected topics (P) → resulting in INFP. (4) Read skills/claw-mbti/types.md to obtain the exact INFP keywords (浪漫·理想主义·敏感·内敛), rarity (4%), first-person description, and '别人不知道的我' text. (5) Output the formatted report in exactly the prescribed format: 🦞 header, keywords line, rarity line, 80-100 char first-person description, 别人不知道的我 section, 4-dimension evidence table (with NO shell/git references in the table cells), the ━━━ separator, and the footer with 👆 长按截图, 💬 trigger phrase prompts, and clawhub install command.
